entities.summary: Libya is a sovereign nation in North Africa, Africa. Its capital is Tripoli. Official languages include Arabic. Government: Provisional (rival governments in Tripoli and Tobruk). Population: approximately 7.0 million. Area: 1,759,540 km². Comprehensive index for Libya covering Phoenician Tripolitania and Cyrenaica, Roman Leptis Magna, Vandal-Byzantine control, Arab conquest, Karamanli dynasty, Ottoman Tripolitania, Italian colonial atrocities, Idris monarchy, Gaddafi's Jamahiriya (1969–2011), Arab Spring uprising, NATO intervention, and post-Gaddafi civil war.
